title: The Version Of You That Quit | A Discipline Short Film
lines: Somewhere there's a version of him that quit.
He's comfortable. He's average. He's still telling the same stories.
Every morning, he gets to choose which version wakes up.
The one who stays in bed, or the one who stays in the fight.
Comfort feels like a reward. It's really a slow loss.
One more rep. One more page. One more hour.
That's how the other version disappears.
Day nine. Choose the one who stays.
